    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="42", exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    # After clicking, the page will navigate to the issues list
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 3: Find the issue about 404

        await search_box.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
